The draw for the provincial fixtures took place on 12 November 2005.{{cite 2006, [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] won the championship after a 1–16 to 1–13 defeat of Cork in the [[2006 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|All-Ireland final]] at [[Croke Park]].{{cite web|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-20012414.html|title=A glorious 29th for Kilkenny |publisher=Irish Examiner|date=4 September 2006|access-date=4 August 2013|first=Jim|last=O'Sullivan}} This was their 29th All-Ireland title overall and their first title since [[2003 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|2003]].{{cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/kilkenny-stutter-to-glory-1.375882|title=Kilkenny stutter to glory|publisher=Irish Times|date=15 September 2003|access-date=4 August 2013}} Kilkenny's [[Henry
